topic: Questions to ask about risk before mining or buying hashrate
hook: Ask these questions before putting any money into mining.

scenes.narration: Rewards are paid in bitcoin, but costs are paid in cash, so a lower bitcoin price squeezes results.
More network hashrate means your share shrinks, and so can your rewards.
Maintenance and hosting charges come out of what you earn, so know them first. Results vary, and they can be negative.

cta: Want to explore how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check the link on my channel page.
title: 3 Risk Questions to Ask Before You Mine Bitcoin
description_body: Price, difficulty and fees all affect mining results. Mining involves costs and risks and is not financial advice.
